prompt: Put the four headings of a runbook in the order the lesson writes them.
Why does the lesson call *Safe now* the heading that matters most?
hint: What does the person on call need before acting?

choices.text: It lists the commands that size the incident
choices.why: That is Look first.

choices.text: It names the people to wake up
choices.why: That is Call.

choices.text: It decides what needs nobody's permission
choices.why: Right: waiting for permission keeps a leaked key live.

choices.text: It is the only heading the check insists on
choices.why: The check requires all four.

prompt: Why does every line under *Look first* name a command from the course?
hint: Compare "check whether the key was used".

choices.text: The commands have already done the working out
choices.why: Right: the reader at night does not have to.

choices.text: Commands are shorter than sentences and fit on a page
choices.why: Length is not the argument.

choices.text: Prose in a runbook cannot be translated
choices.why: Nothing in the lesson is about translation.

choices.text: The check rejects runbooks without commands
choices.why: The check only looks at the headings.

prompt: Which rule had no runbook when the check ran?
hint: The last line before the total.

choices.text: canary
choices.why: Its runbook was ok.

choices.text: rejects
choices.why: Its runbook was ok.

choices.text: denies
choices.why: Right: a page with nothing to read.

choices.text: all three
choices.why: Two were written in the lesson.

prompt: Which problems does `runbooks.py` report? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: A rule with no runbook
choices.why: Yes.

choices.text: A runbook missing one of the four headings
choices.why: Yes.

choices.text: A runbook for a rule that no longer exists
choices.why: Yes: it describes an alert that never fires.

choices.text: A runbook nobody has read for a year
choices.why: It cannot know who read what.

prompt: Why is a leaked key revoked before anybody works out exactly how it leaked?

choices.text: Revoking deletes the evidence of the leak
choices.why: The access log stays; it proved the payout was refused.

choices.text: Each minute of it, the key still works
choices.why: Right: contain, then understand.

choices.text: The ANPD requires revocation within the hour
choices.why: No such rule is in the lesson.

choices.text: The investigation needs the key to be revoked first
choices.why: The trace and the blast ran on a live key.

prompt: How many uses of the payments key came from outside 10.0.4. after the leak?
hint: The line that starts with since.

prompt: Why could the leak expose payment records and payouts, when the assistant only needed refunds?

choices.text: Its scope is wider than the refunds its user needs
choices.why: Right: an overdue ticket became an incident.

choices.text: The canary was in the payments service too
choices.why: The canary is in the system prompt.

choices.text: The address 203.0.113.45 belongs to Tarefa
choices.why: Tarefa's addresses start with 10.0.4.

choices.text: Revoking the key widened what it could do
choices.why: Revoking stops everything the key did.

prompt: What does the refused payout at 14:38 show?

choices.text: The attacker gave up after two reads
choices.why: They tried a third thing.

choices.text: Payouts are always refused from outside addresses
choices.why: It was refused because of the revocation.

choices.text: The revocation at 14:31 had contained it
choices.why: Right: and the log is the proof.

choices.text: The blast was run before the payout
choices.why: The blast at 14:19 showed two reads; run later, it shows all three.

prompt: How many minutes after detection was INC-7 contained?
How is a mistake in the incident's timeline corrected?
hint: The file is only appended to.

choices.text: By editing the line with the mistake
choices.why: Earlier lines are never changed.

choices.text: By deleting the file and starting again
choices.why: That loses the record.

choices.text: By a later note saying what was wrong
choices.why: Right.

choices.text: By asking the reviewer to ignore it
choices.why: The review reads the file as written.

prompt: Which of these does the lesson say not to do in the first hour? Choose all that apply.

choices.text: Let lesson 11's sweep delete the leaked reply
choices.why: Yes: the call log is the evidence.

choices.text: Remove the key from the prompt without revoking it
choices.why: Yes: the key still works for whoever read it.

choices.text: Write a guessed time into the timeline
choices.why: Yes: a time the log confirms, or a note that it is unknown.

choices.text: Revoke the key before the investigation ends
choices.why: That is exactly what the lesson asks for.

prompt: Which item on Resolution 15's list makes INC-7 relevant, according to the lesson?

choices.text: Sensitive data
choices.why: A payment record is not sensitive data in the law's sense.

choices.text: Data of children
choices.why: Nothing says the clients are children.

choices.text: Data at large scale
choices.why: Two records are not large scale.

choices.text: Financial data
choices.why: Right: two payment records.

prompt: Counting from Friday 9 October 2026, what day of October is the deadline for telling the ANPD?
hint: Three working days, skipping a holiday.

prompt: Why is the deadline not Monday 12 October?
hint: Look at the line for that day.

choices.text: Monday is the first working day, so it is day zero
choices.why: Day zero is the Friday.

choices.text: It is a national holiday
choices.why: Right: Our Lady of Aparecida.

choices.text: The ANPD does not count Mondays
choices.why: Only weekends and holidays are skipped.

choices.text: The clock starts when the report is finished
choices.why: It starts when the incident is known.

prompt: Resolution 15 requires a record of every security incident, reported or not, kept for at least ___ years.
hint: The record outlives the incident by a long way.

prompt: Match each heading of a runbook for `denies` to what it could say.
hint: One line on the right fits no heading.

pairs.right: an agent is proposing tool calls outside its scope
the account and the tools in the denied calls
suspend the agent for that account

right_distractors: raise the gate's limit until the alert stops

prompt: Where does the lesson put the review's actions so they are not forgotten?

choices.text: In the incident's timeline, after its last note
choices.why: The timeline records what happened, not what is owed.

choices.text: In the suite, as known failures with their dates
choices.why: Right: the build goes red when a promise is missed.

choices.text: In the communication to the ANPD
choices.why: That goes out once.

choices.text: In the runbook for the canary
choices.why: Runbooks say what to do during an incident.
